title: Asymptotic maximum spectral radius of nonregular graphs
summary: Let $λ_1(n,Δ)$ be the maximum adjacency spectral radius among connected nonregular simple graphs of order $n$ and maximum degree $Δ$. Using effective resistance bounds, explicit comparison graphs and a one-dimensional Wirtinger inequality, we prove that, for every fixed integer $Δ\ge3$, $λ_1(n,Δ)=Δ-c_Δπ^2/(4n^2)+O_Δ(n^{-5/2})$ as $n\to\infty$, where $c_Δ=Δ-1$ for odd $Δ$ and $c_Δ=2(Δ-2)$ for even $Δ$. This proves the asymptotic conjecture posed by Liu [J. Combin. Theory Ser. B 169 (2024), Conjecture 7.1].
